description: An opaque ankle-length burgundy patterned court tunic or outer robe with wide sleeves, dense gold embroidered vertical and edge borders, a high cream linen collar and broad cream cuffs; a narrow ornate waist belt with round hanging fitting; fitted dark leggings and tall brown leather boots. Bare head, simple finger ring, hands loosely clasped. No visible weapon or armor. Blurred stone arch and timber doorway with small edge plants behind the full standing figure.
